newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF DOWNHILL WINNER SYKORA.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF DOWNHILL WINNER SYKORA.

text.p: Following is a brief profile of the winner of a men's World Cup slalom on Sunday:
World Cup wins: 7. Slaloms - Wengen (97), Chamonix (97), Kranjska Gora (97), Madonna di Campiglio (96), Park City (96), Kitzbuehel (96), Lillehammer (96)

Other feats: When Sykora was 18 he attempted to ski for the Netherlands because he thought he had no chance of making the Austrian team. From an athletic family, he is an avid jogger. Returns home to Hochkar after each race in Europe and trains every day on own slalom run outside his house.
